messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have a way to pull that data directly from an external source right now. However, I can give you a quick rundown of Canada’s statutory holidays in 2023, which will help you identify the long weekends:

| Date | Holiday (Canada) | Notes |
|------|------------------|-------|
| Jan 1 | New Year’s Day | 2023‑01‑01 (Sunday) – observed on Monday, Jan 2 |
| Feb 20 | Family Day (BC, AB, ON, SK) | 2023‑02‑20 (Monday) |
| Mar 17 | St. Patrick’s Day (NL) | 2023‑03‑17 (Friday) |
| Apr 7 | Good Friday | 2023‑04‑07 (Friday) |
| Apr 10 | Easter Monday (Federal employees only) | 2023‑04‑10 (Monday) |
| May 22 | Victoria Day | 2023‑05‑22 (Monday) |
| Jun 19 | National Indigenous Peoples Day (AB, BC, MB, NB, NL, NS, PE, QC, SK) | 2023‑06‑19 (Monday) |
| Jul 1 | Canada Day | 2023‑07‑01 (Saturday) – observed on Monday, Jul 3 |
| Aug 7 | Civic Holiday (BC, NB, PE, QC, SK) | 2023‑08‑07 (Monday) |
| Sep 18 | Labour Day | 2023‑09‑18 (Monday) |
| Oct 9 | Thanksgiving (Federal) | 2023‑10‑09 (Monday) |
| Nov 7 | Remembrance Day (Federal) | 2023‑11‑07 (Thursday) – observed on Friday, Nov 8 |
| Dec 25 | Christmas Day | 2023‑12‑25 (Monday) |
| Dec 26 | Boxing Day | 2023‑12‑26 (Tuesday) |

**Long weekends (at least three consecutive days off)**  
(These are based on the statutory holidays above; some provinces may observe additional holidays.)

| Long Weekend | Dates | Province(s) Observed |
|--------------|-------|---------------------|
| New Year’s | 2023‑01‑01 (Sun) + 2023‑01‑02 (Mon) | All provinces |
| Family Day | 2023‑02‑20 (Mon) | BC, AB, ON, SK |
| Good Friday & Easter Monday | 2023‑04‑07 (Fri) + 2023‑04‑10 (Mon) | Federal employees only |
| Victoria Day | 2023‑05‑22 (Mon) | All provinces |
| National Indigenous Peoples Day | 2023‑06‑19 (Mon) | AB, BC, MB, NB, NL, NS, PE, QC, SK |
| Canada Day | 2023‑07‑01 (Sat) + 2023‑07‑03 (Mon) | All provinces |
| Civic Holiday | 2023‑08‑07 (Mon) | BC, NB, PE, QC, SK |
| Labour Day | 2023‑09‑18 (Mon) | All provinces |
| Thanksgiving | 2023‑10‑09 (Mon) | All provinces |
| Remembrance Day | 2023‑11‑07 (Thu) + 2023‑11‑08 (Fri) | All provinces |
| Christmas & Boxing Day | 2023‑12‑25 (Mon) + 2023‑12‑26 (Tue) | All provinces |

If you need the exact dates for each province or want to confirm whether a particular province observes a holiday on a different day, let me know!
